content: Yesu A Hyaˈari Sara Vir Tau
Umudlǝ kaɗǝu pǝci tanggǝrma nǝ sugu mathlǝkǝˈyi ya nyi hyaˈari ndǝ hǝri sǝ kisǝu kǝra ndǝ mǝliya, ndǝ maˈyi ǝni a ndar hu.
Kǝ ndǝ thlǝwa a jahǝnari nji tsǝka kǝra a miya huwa nyi.
Ndǝ gu hu kau, ama nandǝ lari dza Thlagǝ Yesu mai.
Ma tsu nda vǝr ɗǝnga sǝkǝ ɗa kau, kukuthlǝ kǝ ja nji mǝthlǝ tataˈyu lǝhǝu wu dzǝri nda, wu kari pǝr tǝ pwahǝu a vǝr mbǝl.
Nyinyau ǝnga hivǝr, kǝ mathlǝkǝˈyi kǝ uzhau ǝnga kǝra nda a gyiwu ˈyi. Kǝ nja nyi na anǝ nda, “Ara mi nga hya gal ndǝra ǝnga pi wu pama nji tǝta?
Aˈyi ja ngǝ mai, a hyaˈari ja. Hya ɗǝngari sǝra ji na anǝ hyi tsu ja ǝnga hyu Galili.
Ji na, ‘Pakatǝ nǝ nyi nju nǝ nyi Zǝr Ndau a ndu tsa njir bikau, ndu dlakǝya nyi, pǝcir pida makǝrkura nyi ju hyaˈari ǝnga pi.’ ”
Ənggau kǝ ndǝ ɗǝngari sǝra ji na.
Ənggǝra ndǝ sha shili sara ndǝr huwa nyi, kǝ ndǝ nar nyi anǝ zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar kumo a sǝrtangǝ ta ǝnga alenyi nji sǝˈyar kǝ ɗa kǝ patǝu.
Mathlǝkǝˈyi kǝra na sǝˈyar kǝ anǝ cama sǝsǝˈyar kau, nanda ngǝ, Maryamu Magǝdaliya ǝnga Yuwana, ǝnga Maryamu miya Yakubu, ǝnga alenyi mathlǝkǝˈyi kǝra nda ǝni.
Ama nandǝ hǝnggǝri sǝra mathlǝkǝˈyi kǝ na mai, ara ma ndu nggani jiri aˈyi wu ndǝr kǝ mai.

Ama kǝ Biturusu, hyaˈari maɗu ǝnga hwi a ndar huwa nyi, ji nda uzhau, ji tsambiya hu ɗa huwa nyi, kǝl paˈwa kǝra nji pǝɗiya nyi a gwa ca ngǝ baˈa ar dza huwa nyi. Kǝ ji sha a ndu ki ja vǝr ɗǝnga sǝ dǝdǝgur kǝ ɗa kau.
Ar Lagur Vu Imawusu
Pǝci ta tsu njir nu Yesu aˈyi mǝthlǝ kǝra a vǝr maˈyi a ndu mǝlmǝ kǝra nja ngga ǝnga Imawusu, kǝra naɗǝkura nyi wu ɗa miyal mǝɗǝfǝ sara wu Urshalima.
Nda vǝr ndǝr wu pama nda ar kǝra sǝˈyar kǝ ɗarkǝr kau.
Ənggǝra nda vǝr ndǝr wu pamǝ nda nda vǝr thla sǝmana, kǝ Yesu ǝnga kǝrnyi lǝhǝn nda, ja vǝr ɓǝ ǝnga nda,
a lari nyir nda, ama nandǝ tsamǝ ri nyi mai.
Kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Wa thlǝmǝ najaka sǝmana hya vǝr thla wu pama hya, hya vǝr ɓa?” Kǝ ndǝ taˈyi zǝmǝu, ǝnga huɗǝ ndzǝndzau.
Pathlǝ wu pama nda, kǝra nja ngga ǝnga Kǝliyopasu, yiwa nyi, ji na, “Na gǝ mǝthlǝpi wu Urshalima, kǝra na ngǝ sǝnbiya sǝra ɗarkǝr wu pidaˈyar kǝ mai ya?”
Kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Sǝr mi ˈyar ara?” Kǝ ndǝ na anǝ nyi, “Sǝra ɗa ǝnga Yesu ndǝr Nazǝratu. Naja nabi, kǝra ǝnga dǝnama wu sǝra ju na ǝnga mǝl wu mwar Hyal ǝnga nji patǝu,
kǝ pubu dǝdǝgalˈyar ǝnga nji dǝdǝgal nǝr mǝn lǝri nyi aga nja tsǝya nyi, kǝ ndǝ dzǝgwa dlakǝya nyi ar wu dladlakau.
Ɗǝɗǝmǝ ˈyi wu nggani abǝr naja ngu sa mbǝɗana njir Izirayila! Ama kǝ ja ǝshina ngǝ pida makǝrkura nyi ǝnggǝra sǝ kǝ ɗarkǝr.
Kǝl kǝ zhizhi nyi mai, alenyi mathlǝkǝˈyi kǝra wu pama ˈya nar ˈya sǝ dǝdǝgur. Ara ndǝ maˈyi a ndar huwa nyi ǝmudlǝ kaɗǝu,
ama nandǝ thlǝwa dza ja wu hu mai, kǝ ndǝ sha shili, ndǝ nar ˈya, abǝr ndǝ lari waladi kǝra na anǝ ˈya abǝr ǝnga pi nga ja.
Alenyi nju pama ˈya ndǝ maˈyi a ndar hu ndǝ nda lari abangǝ nga nyi ǝnggǝra mathlǝkǝˈyi ta na, ama nanda ǝnga Kǝrnda nandǝ lari nyi mai.”
Kǝ Yesu na anǝ nda, “Əm, nahyi nji kǝra gǝra ǝnga ɗǝnga, aˈyi ɓatsǝ anǝ hyi hya hǝnggǝri ǝnga sǝra nabiˈyar nana mai!
A mbari anǝ Kǝrsiti ja sa ɓwaɓwatǝˈyar kau, ja dzǝgwa gu kadakadarkur nyi, aˈyi abangǝ wa?”
Kǝ ji cabiya nda sǝra tsǝtsǝfǝ nǝ ndǝr Hyal na ar kǝra ja, mbari ar highiɓǝ Musa baˈanǝ tsǝfǝri nabiˈyar patǝu.
Ənggǝra ndǝ dla lǝhǝu wu dzǝri mǝlmǝ kǝra nda vǝr maˈyi a vuwa gwa, kǝ Yesu mǝl ǝnggǝr tǝrabiya a ndumwar nda,
ama kǝ ndǝ ciɗǝ nyi nda vǝr na, “Nggya ǝnga ˈya, ara wagǝu a ɗari, kǝ ja pǝci a gya tǝɗǝri.” Kǝ ji nu nda ji nda nggya ǝnga nda.
Ənggǝra ndǝ nggya aga sǝm sǝr sǝm, kǝ ji hǝri macikǝl ba ji fǝnggǝr barka, kǝ ji ɓǝɓǝlǝwa ba ji tǝkǝna nda.
Ənggau kǝ liya nda pahau, ndǝ tsamǝ ri nyi. Ama kǝ ji sanakǝr wu liya nda.
Ndǝ na anǝ kuvwar nda, “Ɗǝm ya, hu ɗa mǝn aˈyi nyinyau ǝnga caguli ar pǝci kǝra ja vǝr ndǝr anǝ mǝn ar lagu wa, ǝnggǝra ja vǝr cabiya mǝn sǝra tsǝtsǝfau wu ndǝr Hyal wa?”
Kǝ ndǝ hyaˈari ǝnga kusa ndǝ sha a vu Urshalima. Ndǝ thlǝwa nanda kumo a sǝrtangǝ ta ǝkkǝˈyi alenyi nji a vu na,
kǝ ndǝ nar nda, kadzangǝ, “Thlagǝ a hyaˈari! A canǝ nyi ja kǝrnyi anǝ Biturusu!”
Ənga tsu nanda mǝthlǝ kǝ nar nda sǝra ɗa ǝnga nda wu lagu ǝnga ǝnggǝra ndǝ tsamǝ ri Yesu ayukuɗa ji ɓǝɓǝlǝwa nda macikǝl.
Thlǝr Kǝra Yesu Nǝ NyiAnǝ Zǝmbǝlma Nyiˈyar
Tsu nda vǝr ndǝr ar kǝra sǝ kau, kukuthlǝ kǝja Yesu taˈyu wu pama nda, kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Jamǝkur ja nggya ǝnga hyi.”
Ama kǝ ndǝ gǝrahǝ nda vǝr tsǝdzau, ma ndǝ nggani dǝgur ngǝ canǝ nda kǝr.
Kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Mi ngǝ ɗa hyi gǝrahǝ abanga, ǝnga hyu nggya ǝnga tǝkǝkǝr wu ɗǝfuwa hya?
Tsamiya mau tsa yau ǝnga hya yau aga hya lari, nayi ǝnga kǝrɗa ngau. Tsǝkwar ɗa mau, aga hya sǝni abǝr dǝgur aˈyi ǝnga kum ǝnga ɗǝhi, ǝnggǝr kǝ hya vǝr lari ɗa kǝ mai.”
Ayukuɗa ji nana abangau, kǝ ji canǝ nda tsa ja ǝnga hya ja.
Tsu nda vǝr caguli ara sǝ dǝdǝgur kǝ ɗa kau, ama tsu nda ǝnga tǝkǝkǝr wu ɗǝfuwa nda, kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Sǝr sǝm aˈyi ara hyi nga nyi ya?”
Kǝ ndǝ nǝ nyi kalfi kukubwa.
Kǝ ji dlǝwuri ji sǝmku, nanda kǝl tsamǝ nyi.

Ji na anǝ nda, “Sǝˈyar kǝ ngǝ sǝra yi ndǝr anǝ hyi ar kǝri pǝci kǝra yi tsu ǝnga hyi, abǝr a mbari nja nyabiya sǝra nji tsǝfǝri ar kǝra yau wu dlaɗǝ nǝ lagu Musa, ǝnga tsǝfǝ nǝ nabiˈyar ǝnga Zabura tsu.”
Kǝ ji mǝliya ndǝ sǝnbiya sǝra tsǝtsǝfau wu ndǝr Hyal,
Ji nar nda, “Abangǝ nga nyi tsǝtsǝfau, abǝr a ɗar tsaˈa anǝ Kǝrsiti ja lari ɓwaɓwatǝu, pǝci makǝrkura nyi ba ja hyaˈari sara vir tau.
Ətsu wu thlǝmǝ nyi nga nju nda tǝtǝlna ndǝr Hyal anǝ njir duniya patǝ aga nda tubi nda uya tǝfǝbiya bikǝr nda. Nju nda dzǝguya sǝ kǝ wu Urshalima.
Nahyi ngǝ sakida sǝˈyar kau.
Kǝja, yu nda sǝwa hyi sǝra dǝɗa mǝliya hyi alkawal abǝr ju sǝwa. Ama hya sǝkǝ wu mǝlmǝ kwatahǝu, kǝl nji nǝ hyi dǝnama sara dǝmǝlmau.”
Nji Hǝr Yesu A Dǝmǝlmau
Kǝ ji hǝbiya nda a biyar ya mǝlmau, ndǝ maˈyi ba a vu Bethlani. A ndǝna, ji hyaˈana tsa ja dǝmǝlmau kǝ ji fǝnggǝr nda barka.
Ənggǝra ja vǝr fǝ barka anǝ nda, kǝ ji tǝkǝbiya dzǝ ǝnga nda, ji maˈyi a dǝmǝlmau.
Nanda tsu ndǝ dzǝgwa dlǝvǝ nyi, ndǝ sha a vu Urshalima, nyinyau ǝnga huɗǝ pǝrtǝu gagaɗau.
Ndu shili parangǝ tsu wu ki Hyal nda vǝr fal Hyal.
